title.zh: 卷288 列傳七十五 鄂尔泰 张廷玉
title.en: Volume 288 Biographies 75: E Ertai, Zhang Tingyu
title.raw: 卷288 列傳七十五 鄂尔泰 张廷玉

sentences.zh: 列傳七十五

translations.literal: Biographies 75
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 75

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰弟鄂爾奇子鄂弼鄂寧

translations.literal: Oertai's brother Oerqi; his sons Ebi and Ening
translations.idiomatic: Oerqi (Oertai's brother); Ebi and Ening (his sons)

sentences.zh: 張廷玉子若靄若澄若渟從子若溎

translations.literal: Zhang Tingyu's sons Ruowei, Ruocheng, and Ruoting; his nephew Ruowei
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyu's sons Ruowei, Ruocheng, and Ruoting, and his nephew Ruowei

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰，字毅庵，西林覺羅氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人，世居汪欽。

translations.literal: Oertai, courtesy name Yi'an, of the Xilin Gioro clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner, whose family had long resided at Wangqin.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai (courtesy name Yi'an), of the Xilin Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner whose family had long lived at Wangqin.

sentences.zh: 國初有屯泰者，以七村附太祖，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty there was Tun Tai, who submitted seven villages to the Taizu and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the dynasty's founding years, Tun Tai brought seven villages into allegiance to the Taizu and was made a company commander (niru ejen).

sentences.zh: 子圖捫，事太宗，從戰大凌河，擊明將張理，陣沒，授備禦世職。

translations.literal: His son Tumen served Taizong, followed him in the campaign at Dalinghe, attacked the Ming general Zhang Li, fell in battle, and was granted a hereditary assistant commandant's post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tumen served Taizong, fought at Dalinghe, attacked the Ming general Zhang Li, and was killed in battle; he was granted a hereditary assistant commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: In the early Yongzheng reign he was worshipped at the Shrine of Loyalty and Faithfulness.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Yongzheng period he was enshrined in the Zhongzhong Shrine.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰，其曾孫也。

translations.literal: Oertai was his great-grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai was his great-grandson.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年舉人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He received his juren degree in the thirty-eighth year of the Kangxi reign.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，襲佐領，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year he inherited the assistant commandantcy and was appointed a third-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year he inherited his family's assistant commandant post and was made a third-rank imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從聖祖獵，和詩稱旨。

translations.literal: He accompanied the Sage Ancestor on the hunt and composed verse in harmony with the theme that pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On a hunt with the Kangxi Emperor he composed responsive verse that won imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，遷內務府員外郎。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he was transferred to be an assistant department director in the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year he was promoted to assistant department director in the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 世宗在籓邸，偶有所囑，鄂爾泰拒之。

translations.literal: When Shizong was still in his princely residence he occasionally made requests, but Oertai refused them.
translations.idiomatic: While the future Yongzheng Emperor was still prince, he sometimes asked favors of him, but Oertai refused.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，召曰：「汝為郎官拒皇子，其執法甚堅。」

translations.literal: When Shizong took the throne he summoned him and said: "As a bureau officer you refused the prince—your enforcement of the law was very firm."
translations.idiomatic: When Yongzheng took the throne he summoned him and said, "As a bureau officer you refused the prince's requests—your adherence to the law was remarkably firm."

sentences.zh: 深慰諭之。

translations.literal: He comforted and praised him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: He comforted and praised him at length.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，充雲南鄉試考官，特擢江蘇布政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he served as examiner for the Yunnan provincial examination and was specially promoted to Jiangsu provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he served as examiner for Yunnan's provincial examinations and was specially promoted to Jiangsu administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 於廨中建春風亭，禮致能文士，錄其詩文為南邦黎獻集。

translations.literal: In his yamen he built the Chunfeng Pavilion, treated men of literary talent with ceremony, and collected their poetry and prose into the anthology Contributions of the Southern Realm.
translations.idiomatic: In his official residence he built the Spring Breeze Pavilion, honored men of letters, and compiled their writings into the anthology Offerings of the Southern Realm.

sentences.zh: 以應得公使銀買穀三萬三千四百石有奇，分貯蘇、松、常三府備賑貸。

translations.literal: With the public envoy silver to which he was entitled he purchased more than thirty-three thousand four hundred piculs of grain, stored in divisions across Suzhou, Songjiang, and Changzhou for famine relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: He used his allotted public envoy silver to buy more than 33,400 piculs of grain, stored across Suzhou, Songjiang, and Changzhou for famine relief and lending.

sentences.zh: 察太湖水利，擬疏下游吳淞、白茆，役未舉。

translations.literal: He surveyed Taihu water conservancy and proposed dredging the Wusong and Baimao downstream; the project was not yet undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected Taihu waterworks and proposed dredging the Wusong and Baimao channels downstream, but the work was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 三年，遷廣西巡撫，甫上官，調雲南，以巡撫治總督事。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Guangxi governor; as soon as he took office he was reassigned to Yunnan, handling affairs as governor while holding the title of grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made Guangxi governor, but scarcely had he assumed office when he was transferred to Yunnan, where as grand coordinator he handled governor-general affairs.

sentences.zh: 貴州仲家苗為亂二十餘年，巡撫石禮哈、提督馬會伯請用兵，上未即許。

translations.literal: The Zhongjia Miao of Guizhou had been in revolt for more than twenty years; Governor Shi Liha and Regional Commander Ma Huibo requested military action, but the emperor did not immediately approve.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongjia Miao in Guizhou had rebelled for more than twenty years; Governor Shi Liha and Regional Commander Ma Huibo asked for troops, but the emperor did not approve at once.

sentences.zh: 巡撫何世璂疏言仲家苗藥箭銛利，地勢險阻，用兵不易，上即命世璂招撫，久未定，詔諮鄂爾泰。

translations.literal: Governor He Shihong memorialized that the Zhongjia Miao's poisoned arrows were sharp and the terrain perilous, so military action would not be easy; the emperor at once ordered Shihong to offer surrender terms, but after long indecision he commanded Oertai for counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Governor He Shihong reported that the Zhongjia Miao's poisoned arrows were keen and the terrain forbidding, making war difficult; the emperor ordered Shihong to negotiate surrender, but after long stalemate he sought Oertai's advice.

sentences.zh: 四年春，疏言：「雲、貴大患無如​​苗、蠻。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year he memorialized: "The great calamities of Yunnan and Guizhou are none worse than the Miao and the Man barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year he wrote: "Yunnan and Guizhou's gravest troubles are the Miao and the tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 欲安民必制夷，欲制夷必改土歸流。

translations.literal: To settle the people one must control the tribes; to control the tribes one must replace native rule with direct administration.
translations.idiomatic: To secure the people one must control the tribes; to control the tribes one must replace native chieftains with regular officials (gaitu guiliu).

sentences.zh: 而苗疆多與鄰省相錯，即如東川、烏蒙、鎮雄，皆四川土府，東川距雲南四百餘里。

translations.literal: Yet the Miao frontier largely overlaps neighboring provinces—for example Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong are all native prefectures of Sichuan, and Dongchuan lies more than four hundred li from Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao frontier often straddles neighboring provinces. Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong are Sichuan native prefectures, yet Dongchuan is more than four hundred li from Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 去冬烏蒙攻掠東川，滇兵擊退，而川省令箭方至。

translations.literal: Last winter Wumeng raided Dongchuan; Yunnan troops repulsed them, yet Sichuan's command arrows arrived only afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Last winter Wumeng attacked Dongchuan; Yunnan troops drove them back before Sichuan's orders even arrived.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙距雲南省城亦僅六百餘里，錢糧不過三百餘兩，取於下者百倍。

translations.literal: Wumeng is only some six hundred-odd li from the Yunnan provincial capital, yet its land tax amounted to little more than three hundred taels while what was exacted below was a hundredfold.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng lies only six hundred-odd li from the Yunnan capital, yet its registered land tax was barely three hundred taels while exactions from the people ran a hundred times higher.

sentences.zh: 一年四小派，三年一大派，小派計錢，大派計兩。

translations.literal: Every year there were four minor exactions and every three years a major one—the minor reckoned in cash, the major in taels.
translations.idiomatic: Every year brought four minor levies and every three years a major one—minor levies counted in cash, major ones in taels.

sentences.zh: 土司娶子婦，土民三載不敢婚。

translations.literal: When a native prefect took a daughter-in-law, common people dared not marry for three years.
translations.idiomatic: When a native chief took a bride, commoners dared not marry for three years.

sentences.zh: 土民被殺，親族尚出墊刀數十金，終身不見天日。

translations.literal: When a commoner was killed, his kin still had to pay dozens of taels of 'knife money,' and he would not see daylight for life.
translations.idiomatic: When a commoner was murdered, his kin still paid dozens of taels in 'knife money' compensation, and the killer lived out his days unseen by daylight.

sentences.zh: 東川雖已改流，尚為土目盤據，文武長寓省城，膏腴四百里無人敢墾。

translations.literal: Though Dongchuan had already been converted to direct rule, it was still dominated by native headmen; civil and military officials long resided at the provincial capital, and for four hundred li of fertile land none dared reclaim it.
translations.idiomatic: Though Dongchuan had been converted to direct administration, native headmen still held sway; officials stayed in the provincial capital, and four hundred li of rich land lay unreclaimed.

sentences.zh: 若改隸雲南，俾臣得相機改流，可設三府、一鎮。

translations.literal: If transferred to Yunnan's jurisdiction so that your subject might seize the moment to carry out further conversion, three prefectures and one garrison could be established.
translations.idiomatic: If placed under Yunnan so that I might convert native domains as opportunity allows, three prefectures and one garrison could be set up.

sentences.zh: 此事連四川者也。

translations.literal: This matter involves Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: This concerns Sichuan as well.

sentences.zh: 廣西土府、州、縣、峒、寨等一百五十餘員，分隸南寧、太平、思恩、慶遠四府。

translations.literal: Guangxi has more than a hundred and fifty native prefectures, departments, counties, stockades, and villages under Nanning, Taiping, Sinan, and Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi has more than 150 native prefectures, departments, counties, stockades, and villages under Nanning, Taiping, Sinan, and Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 其為邊患，自泗城土府外，皆土目橫於土司。

translations.literal: As border troubles, except for the Sincheng native prefecture, all stem from native headmen dominating the native chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Border troubles, except at Sincheng native prefecture, all arise from headmen lording it over native chiefs.

sentences.zh: 黔、粵以牂牁江為界，而粵屬西隆州與黔屬普安州越江互相鬥入。

translations.literal: Guizhou and Guangdong take the Zangge River as their boundary, yet Guangdong's Xilong Department and Guizhou's Pu'an Department cross the river and encroach on each other.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou and Guangdong take the Zangge River as their border, yet Guangdong's Xilong and Guizhou's Pu'an cross the river and encroach on each other.

sentences.zh: 苗寨寥闊，將吏推諉。

translations.literal: The Miao stockades are vast and the officers pass blame back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: Miao stockades stretch across vast territory, and officers shift blame onto one another.

sentences.zh: 應以江北歸黔，江南歸粵，增州設營，形格勢禁。

translations.literal: The north of the river should belong to Guizhou, the south to Guangdong; add departments and establish camps so that form checks force.
translations.idiomatic: The north bank should go to Guizhou and the south to Guangdong; add prefectures and garrisons to constrain each other by geography.

sentences.zh: 此事連廣西者也。

translations.literal: This matter involves Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: This concerns Guangxi as well.

sentences.zh: 滇邊西南界以瀾滄江，江外為車裡、緬甸、老撾諸境，其江內鎮沅、威遠、元江、新平、普洱、茶山諸夷，巢穴深邃，出沒魯魁、哀牢間，無事近患腹心，有事遠通外國。

translations.literal: Yunnan's southwestern border is marked by the Lancang River; beyond the river lie Cheli, Burma, Laos, and other territories, while within it are the tribes of Zhenyuan, Weiyuan, Yuanjiang, Xinping, Pu'er, and Chashan—lairs deep in the mountains, raiding between Lukui and Ailao; when quiet they threaten the heartland, when active they link with foreign states.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's southwest border follows the Lancang River. Beyond it lie Cheli, Burma, and Laos; within it the tribes of Zhenyuan, Weiyuan, Yuanjiang, Xinping, Pu'er, and Chashan nest in deep mountains and raid between Lukui and Ailao—peaceable times they menace the interior, troubled times they reach abroad.

sentences.zh: 論者謂江外宜土不宜流，江內宜流不宜土。

translations.literal: Commentators say that beyond the river native rule is fitting and direct administration is not, while within the river direct administration is fitting and native rule is not.
translations.idiomatic: Some hold that beyond the river native chiefs should rule and direct administration should not, while within the river the reverse applies.

sentences.zh: 此雲南宜治之邊夷也。

translations.literal: These are the frontier tribes of Yunnan that ought to be governed.
translations.idiomatic: These are the frontier peoples Yunnan must govern.

sentences.zh: 貴州土司向無鉗束群苗之責，苗患甚於土司。

translations.literal: Guizhou's native chiefs have never borne responsibility for restraining the Miao clans; the Miao menace is worse than the chiefs themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou native chiefs were never charged with controlling the Miao; the Miao threat exceeds that of the chiefs.

sentences.zh: 苗疆四圍幾三千餘里，千三百餘寨，古州踞其中，群寨環其外。

translations.literal: The Miao territory spans nearly three thousand li on all sides with more than thirteen hundred stockades; Guzhou sits at the center with stockades ringing it.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao frontier covers nearly three thousand li and more than 1,300 stockades, with Guzhou at the center and stockades all around.

sentences.zh: 左有清江可北達楚，右有都江可南通粵，蟠據梗隔，遂成化外。

translations.literal: To the left the Qing River reaches north to Chu; to the right the Du River reaches south to Yue; coiled and blocking, it has become land beyond transformation.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing River on the left links north to Huguang; the Du River on the right links south to Guangdong; entrenched and obstructing, the region has become a land apart.

sentences.zh: 如欲開江路通黔、粵，非勒兵深入遍加剿撫不可。

translations.literal: To open the river route and link Guizhou and Guangdong, troops must be driven deep in a thorough campaign of suppression and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: To open river routes linking Guizhou and Guangdong, troops must advance deep with full suppression and pacification.

sentences.zh: 此貴州宜治之邊夷也。

translations.literal: These are the frontier tribes of Guizhou that ought to be governed.
translations.idiomatic: These are the frontier peoples Guizhou must govern.

sentences.zh: 臣思前明流、土之分，原因煙瘴新疆，未習風土，故因地制宜，使之鄉導彈壓。

translations.literal: Your subject reflects that the Ming division between direct and native rule arose because the miasmic new frontier was unfamiliar with local custom, so they adapted to conditions and used natives as guides and to suppress and hold down the region.
translations.idiomatic: I consider that the Ming split between direct and native rule arose because the malarial new territories were unfamiliar terrain, so they used native chiefs as guides and local enforcers.

sentences.zh: 今歷數百載，以夷治夷，即以盜治盜，苗、倮無追贓抵命之憂，土司無革職削地之罰。

translations.literal: Now after several hundred years, using tribes to govern tribes is using thieves to govern thieves; Miao and Luo have no fear of pursuing stolen goods or paying with life, and native chiefs have no penalty of dismissal or land confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: After centuries, ruling tribes with tribes means ruling thieves with thieves; Miao and Luo face no demand to return loot or forfeit life, and native chiefs face no dismissal or loss of territory.

sentences.zh: 直至事上聞，行賄詳結，上司亦不深求，以為鎮靜，邊民無所控訴。

translations.literal: Only when matters reached the throne did they bribe to close the case; superiors did not investigate deeply, deeming it quiescence, and border people had nowhere to appeal.
translations.idiomatic: Only when cases reached the court did offenders bribe their way to closure; superiors did not probe deeply, calling it peace, and border people had no recourse.

sentences.zh: 若不剷蔓塞源，縱兵刑財賦事事整理，皆非治本。

translations.literal: Unless the vines are cut and the source blocked, even if troops, punishments, and taxes are all put in order, none of it reaches the root.
translations.idiomatic: Unless the root cause is removed, organizing troops, punishments, and taxes will not touch the fundamental problem.

sentences.zh: 改流之法：計擒為上，兵剿次之；

translations.literal: The method of conversion: stratagem and capture is best, military suppression next;
translations.idiomatic: The method of conversion: stratagem and capture first, military suppression second;

sentences.zh: 令其自首為上，勒獻次之。

translations.literal: inducing voluntary surrender is best, forced submission next.
translations.idiomatic: inducing voluntary surrender first, forced submission second.

sentences.zh: 惟剿夷必練兵，練兵必選將。

translations.literal: Only to suppress the tribes must troops be trained, and to train troops generals must be chosen.
translations.idiomatic: To suppress the tribes one must train troops, and to train troops one must choose capable commanders.

sentences.zh: 誠能賞罰嚴明，將士用命，先治內，後攘外，實邊防百世之利。」

translations.literal: If rewards and punishments are truly strict and clear and officers and soldiers obey orders, governing the interior first and then securing the exterior will be a benefit to the border defense for a hundred generations."
translations.idiomatic: With strict rewards and punishments and obedient troops, pacifying the interior before securing the frontier would secure the border for generations."

sentences.zh: 疏入，上深然之。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, the emperor deeply approved it.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor strongly endorsed it.

sentences.zh: 會石禮哈疏報遣兵擊破谷隆、長寨、者貢、羊城諸隘，擒其渠阿革、阿給及諸苗之從為亂者，上命交鄂爾泰按讞。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Shi Liha memorialized that troops had been sent to break the passes at Gulong, Changzhai, Zhegong, and Yangcheng, capturing the ringleaders Age and Agei and the Miao who followed the rebellion; the emperor ordered the case handed to Oertai for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Shi Liha reported that troops had broken the passes at Gulong, Changzhai, Zhegong, and Yangcheng and captured ringleaders Age and Agei along with rebel Miao; the emperor ordered Oertai to try the case.

sentences.zh: 五月，鄂爾泰遣兵三道入：一自谷隆，一自焦山，一自馬落孔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Oertai sent troops in on three routes: one from Gulong, one from Jiaoshan, one from Maluokong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Oertai sent three columns: one through Gulong, one through Jiaoshan, one through Maluokong.

sentences.zh: 破三十六寨，降二十一寨，撫苗民五百餘戶、二千餘口，察出荒熟田地三萬畝。

translations.literal: They broke thirty-six stockades, received the surrender of twenty-one, pacified more than five hundred Miao households and two thousand-odd persons, and surveyed thirty thousand mu of wasteland and cultivated fields.
translations.idiomatic: They stormed thirty-six stockades, accepted twenty-one surrenders, pacified more than 500 Miao households and 2,000 people, and registered 30,000 mu of fallow and cultivated land.

sentences.zh: 又以鎮遠土知府刁澣、霑益土知州安於籓素兇詐，計擒之；

translations.literal: He also, because the Zhenyuan native prefect Diao Huan and the Zhanyi native department magistrate An Yufan had long been vicious and deceitful, captured them by stratagem;
translations.idiomatic: He also captured by stratagem the Zhenyuan native prefect Diao Huan and the Zhanyi native magistrate An Yufan, who had long been brutal and treacherous;

sentences.zh: 者樂甸土司刁聯鬥乞免死，改土歸流。

translations.literal: the Zheledian native chief Diao Liandou begged to be spared death and submitted to conversion and direct rule.
translations.idiomatic: the Zheledian native chief Diao Liandou pleaded for his life and accepted conversion to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰疏報仲家苗悉定。

translations.literal: Oertai memorialized that the Zhongjia Miao were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai reported that the Zhongjia Miao were fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其成功速，令議敘。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his swift success and ordered discussion of rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his rapid success and ordered his merits recorded for promotion.

sentences.zh: 旋條上經理仲苗諸事，報可。

translations.literal: He soon submitted in detail the matters of administering the Zhong Miao; approval was returned.
translations.idiomatic: He soon submitted detailed plans for administering the Zhong Miao, which were approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，真除雲貴總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was formally appointed governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was formally confirmed as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四川烏蒙土司祿萬鍾為亂，侵東川。

translations.literal: The Wumeng native chief of Sichuan, Lu Wanzhong, rebelled and invaded Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wanzhong, native chief of Wumeng in Sichuan, rebelled and raided Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰請以東川改隸雲南，上從之。

translations.literal: Oertai requested that Dongchuan be transferred to Yunnan's jurisdiction; the emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai asked that Dongchuan be placed under Yunnan; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 仍命會四川總督岳鍾琪按治，招其渠祿鼎坤出降。

translations.literal: He was still ordered to join Sichuan Governor-General Yue Zhongqi in handling the case and to summon the ringleader Lu Dingkun to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: He was also ordered to work with Sichuan governor-general Yue Zhongqi and summon the rebel leader Lu Dingkun to submit.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰令鼎坤招萬鍾，數往不就撫，乃檄總兵劉起元率師討之，破其所居寨。

translations.literal: Oertai ordered Dingkun to summon Wanzhong, but after several visits he would not accept pacification; he then dispatched Regional Commander Liu Qiyuan to lead troops against him and broke his stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai had Dingkun summon Wanzhong, but Wanzhong refused surrender after repeated visits; Oertai then ordered regional commander Liu Qiyuan to attack and destroy his stronghold.

sentences.zh: 萬鍾走匿鎮雄土司隴慶侯所。

translations.literal: Wanzhong fled and hid with the Zhenxiong native chief Long Qinghou.
translations.idiomatic: Wanzhong fled and took refuge with the Zhenxiong native chief Long Qinghou.

sentences.zh: 五年，萬鍾詣鍾琪降，慶侯亦詣鍾琪請改土歸流。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Wanzhong went to Zhongqi to surrender, and Qinghou also went to Zhongqi requesting conversion and direct rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Wanzhong surrendered to Zhongqi, and Qinghou also came to Zhongqi to request conversion to direct rule.

sentences.zh: 上命鍾琪以萬鍾、慶侯交鄂爾泰按讞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Zhongqi to hand Wanzhong and Qinghou over to Oertai for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Zhongqi to deliver Wanzhong and Qinghou to Oertai for trial.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were recorded and he was granted the hereditary rank of Baitalabuleha fan.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was granted the hereditary rank of Baitalabuleha.

sentences.zh: 三月，鎮沅倮刁如珍等戕官焚掠，遣兵討平之，獲如珍。

translations.literal: In the third month the Zhenyuan Luo Diao Ruzhen and others killed officials and burned and plundered; troops were sent to suppress them and Ruzhen was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Zhenyuan Luo chief Diao Ruzhen and others murdered officials and raided; Oertai sent troops to suppress them and captured Ruzhen.

sentences.zh: 泗城土知府岑映宸縱其眾出掠，又發兵屯者相，立七營。

translations.literal: The Sincheng native prefect Cen Yingchen let his followers raid abroad and also sent troops to garrison Zhexiang, establishing seven camps.
translations.idiomatic: Sincheng native prefect Cen Yingchen allowed his followers to raid abroad and stationed troops at Zhexiang with seven camps.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰疏劾，令諸道兵候檄進討，映宸乞免死存祀，改土歸流。

translations.literal: Oertai memorialized impeaching him and ordered troops of the various circuits to await his dispatch and advance to attack; Yingchen begged to be spared death and allowed to maintain sacrifices, and submitted to conversion and direct rule.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai impeached him and ordered circuit troops to await orders to attack; Yingchen pleaded for his life and the preservation of ancestral rites and accepted conversion to direct rule.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰請映宸送浙江原籍，留其弟映翰奉祀。

translations.literal: Oertai requested that Yingchen be sent to his native place in Zhejiang and that his younger brother Yinghan be left to maintain the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai asked that Yingchen be sent to his native Zhejiang and that his brother Yinghan remain to maintain the ancestral rites.

sentences.zh: 七月，發兵與湖北師會討定謬衝花苗，獲其渠，降其餘眾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he sent troops to join Hubei forces in suppressing the Miaochonghua Miao, captured their ringleader, and received the surrender of the rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he sent troops to join Hubei forces against the Miaochonghua Miao, captured their leader, and accepted the surrender of the remainder.

sentences.zh: 威遠倮札鐵匠等、新平倮李百疊等應如珍為亂。

translations.literal: The Weiyuan Luo Zha Tiejian and others and the Xinping Luo Li Baidie and others followed Ruzhen in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The Weiyuan Luo Zha Tiejian and the Xinping Luo Li Baidie joined Ruzhen's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 九月，鄂爾泰檄臨元總兵孫宏本率師討之，獲札鐵匠，降李百疊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Oertai dispatched Linyuan Regional Commander Sun Hongben to lead troops against them, captured Zha Tiejian, and received Li Baidie's surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Oertai ordered Linyuan regional commander Sun Hongben to attack them, captured Zha Tiejian, and accepted Li Baidie's surrender.

sentences.zh: 威遠、新平皆定。

translations.literal: Weiyuan and Xinping were both pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Weiyuan and Xinping were both pacified.

sentences.zh: 十一月，招降長寨後路苗百八十四寨，編戶口，定額賦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he induced the surrender of a hundred and eighty-four stockades of the rear-route Miao of Changzhai, registered households, and fixed quota taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he induced 184 rear-route Changzhai Miao stockades to surrender, registered households, and set fixed tax quotas.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎，進世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He received an edict of commendation and was advanced in hereditary rank to first-class Adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: He received imperial commendation and was promoted in hereditary rank to first-class Adahahan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，攻破雲南倮窩泥種，取六茶山地千餘里，劃界建城，置官吏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he broke the Yunnan Luo Wonizhong, took more than a thousand li of the Liuchashan region, demarcated boundaries, built a city, and appointed officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he defeated the Yunnan Luo Wonizhong, seized more than a thousand li in the Liuchashan region, demarcated borders, built a walled town, and appointed officials.

sentences.zh: 雲南南徼地與安南接，前總督高其倬疏言安南國界應屬內地者百二十里，請以賭咒河為界。

translations.literal: Yunnan's southern frontier adjoins Annam; the former governor-general Gao Qisuo memorialized that a hundred and twenty li of Annam's border ought to belong to the interior and requested the Duzhou River as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's southern frontier borders Annam; former governor-general Gao Qisuo argued that 120 li of borderland should belong to China and proposed the Duzhou River as the boundary.

sentences.zh: 安南國王黎維祹奏辯，上命鄂爾泰清察。

translations.literal: The king of Annam, Li Weitao, memorialized in rebuttal; the emperor ordered Oertai to investigate clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Annam's king Li Weitao protested in a memorial; the emperor ordered Oertai to investigate.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰請與地八十里，於鉛廠山下小河內四十里立界，上從之，敕諭安南。

translations.literal: Oertai requested ceding eighty li of territory and establishing the boundary forty li within the small river below Qianchang Mountain; the emperor assented and issued an edict to Annam.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai proposed ceding 80 li and setting the border 40 li inside the stream below Leadworks Mountain; the emperor agreed and sent instructions to Annam.

sentences.zh: 六年，維祹表謝，上嘉其知禮，命復與四十里。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Weitao memorialized thanks; the emperor praised his knowledge of propriety and ordered another forty li restored to him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Weitao sent thanks; the emperor praised his propriety and ordered another 40 li returned to Annam.

sentences.zh: 旋討擒東川法戛土目祿天佑、則補土目祿世豪；

translations.literal: He soon campaigned and captured the Dongchuan Faga native headman Lu Tianyou and the Zebu native headman Lu Shihao;
translations.idiomatic: He soon captured the Dongchuan Faga headman Lu Tianyou and the Zebu headman Lu Shihao;

sentences.zh: 按治米貼土目祿永孝，論斬。

translations.literal: tried the Mitie native headman Lu Yongxiao and sentenced him to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: tried the Mitie headman Lu Yongxiao and sentenced him to death.

sentences.zh: 永孝妻陸氏結倮儸為亂，檄總兵張耀祖討之，攻克門坎山。

translations.literal: Yongxiao's wife, Lady Lu, rallied the Luoluo in rebellion; he dispatched Regional Commander Zhang Yaozu to suppress them and captured Menkan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxiao's wife Lady Lu rallied the Luoluo in rebellion; he ordered regional commander Zhang Yaozu to attack and took Menkan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 師入，獲陸氏。

translations.literal: The army entered and captured Lady Lu.
translations.idiomatic: The troops advanced and captured Lady Lu.

sentences.zh: 米貼平。

translations.literal: Mitie was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Mitie was pacified.

sentences.zh: 廣西八達寨儂顏光色等為亂，提督田畯不能討。

translations.literal: At Guangxi's Bada stockade the Nong Yan Guangse and others rebelled; Regional Commander Tian Jun could not suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: At Guangxi's Bada stockade the Nong chieftain Yan Guangse rebelled; regional commander Tian Jun could not suppress them.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰遣兵往，儂殺光色以降。

translations.literal: Oertai sent troops there; the Nong killed Guangse to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai sent troops; the Nong killed Guangse and submitted.

sentences.zh: 上命鄂爾泰總督雲、貴、廣西三省，發帑十萬犒師。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Oertai governor-general over Yunnan, Guizhou, and Guangxi, and disbursed a hundred thousand taels from the treasury to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Oertai governor-general of Yunnan, Guizhou, and Guangxi and disbursed 100,000 taels from the treasury to reward the army.

sentences.zh: 旋又撫貴州拜克猛、長寨、古羊等生苗百四十五寨。

translations.literal: He soon also pacified a hundred and forty-five stockades of the raw Miao of Guizhou at Baike, Changzhai, Guyang, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: He soon pacified 145 raw Miao stockades in Guizhou at Baike, Changzhai, Guyang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 十月，萬壽節，雲南卿雲見，鄂爾泰疏聞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the Longevity Festival, auspicious clouds appeared in Yunnan; Oertai memorialized to report it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the emperor's birthday, auspicious clouds appeared in Yunnan; Oertai reported it in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，命超授三等阿思哈尼哈番，雲、貴兩省巡撫、提督、總兵，文知縣、武千總以上，皆加級。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year he was ordered specially promoted to third-rank Ashanihan, and all governors, regional commanders, and brigade generals of Yunnan and Guizhou, as well as civil county magistrates and military company commanders and above, were advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year he was specially promoted to third-rank Ashanihan, and all officials in Yunnan and Guizhou from governors and regional commanders down to county magistrates and company commanders received rank advances.

sentences.zh: 三月，令按察使張廣泗率師攻貴州丹江雞溝生苗，破其寨，種人悉降。

translations.literal: In the third month he ordered Surveillance Commissioner Zhang Guangsi to lead troops against the raw Miao of Danjiang Jigou in Guizhou, broke their stockade, and all the tribesmen surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he ordered surveillance commissioner Zhang Guangsi to attack the raw Miao of Danjiang Jigou in Guizhou, destroyed their stockade, and all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 上下九股、清水江、古州諸地以次定。

translations.literal: Upper and lower Jiugu, Qingshui River, Guzhou, and other places were successively pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The regions of upper and lower Jiugu, Qingshui River, Guzhou, and elsewhere were brought under control one after another.

sentences.zh: 下部議敘，鄂爾泰疏辭，而乞予曾祖圖捫封典，俾昭忠祠位得改書贈官，列大臣之末，上允其請，仍命議敘。

translations.literal: The ministries deliberated on merit awards. Oertai memorialized declining them, but requested conferral of posthumous honors upon his great-grandfather Tumun, so that the tablet in the Zhaozhong Shrine could be rewritten with a posthumously granted office and listed at the end of the grand ministers. The emperor granted his request but still ordered deliberation on the merit awards.
translations.idiomatic: When the ministries recommended him for honors, Oertai declined in a memorial but asked that posthumous honors be granted to his great-grandfather Tumun so the Zhaozhong Shrine tablet could be revised to show a conferred posthumous rank, placed at the end of the grand ministers' row. The emperor granted this but still ordered the honors deliberation to proceed.

sentences.zh: 七月，招安順、高耀等寨生苗及儂、仲諸種人內附。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, he induced the raw Miao of Anshun, Gaoyao, and other stockades, and peoples of the Nong and Zhong tribes, to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he brought the raw Miao of stockades such as Anshun and Gaoyao, together with the Nong, Zhong, and other tribes, to submit to the empire.

sentences.zh: 十月，雲南趙州醴泉出，鄂爾泰疏聞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month sweet springs appeared at Zhao Prefecture in Yunnan; Oertai reported by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month sweet springs flowed at Zhao Prefecture, Yunnan, and Oertai reported it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上褒鄂爾泰化民成俗，格天致瑞，尋加少保。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Oertai for transforming the people and establishing customs, moving Heaven to bring auspicious omens, and soon added Junior Guardian to his titles.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended Oertai for civilizing the people and establishing proper customs, saying he had moved Heaven to bring auspicious signs, and shortly thereafter promoted him to Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，招黎平、都勻等寨生苗內附。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, he induced the raw Miao of Liping, Duyun, and other stockades to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year he brought the raw Miao of Liping, Duyun, and other stockades to submit.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰既討定群苗為亂者，諸土司懾軍威納土，疆理其地，置郡縣，設營汛，重定三省及四川界域，而諸土司世守其地，一旦歸版籍，其渠誅夷、遷徙皆無幸。

translations.literal: After Oertai had suppressed and pacified the rebellious Miao groups, the various native chiefs, awed by military might, surrendered their lands. He surveyed and organized the territory, established prefectures and counties, set up garrisons, and redefined the boundaries of the three provinces and Sichuan. The native chiefs who for generations had held their lands now entered the imperial register at once; their ringleaders who were executed, exiled, or resettled had no hope of escape.
translations.idiomatic: After Oertai crushed the rebellious Miao, the native chiefs, intimidated by his military power, surrendered their domains under the gaitu guiliu policy of conversion to direct administration. He reorganized the territory, established prefectures and counties, posted garrisons, and redrew the borders of the three southwestern provinces and Sichuan. Chiefs who had held their lands by hereditary tenure for generations now entered the imperial rolls; their ringleaders who were executed, relocated, or driven out could expect no mercy.

sentences.zh: 屬苗內憤，烏蒙倮最狡悍，總兵劉起元移鎮其地，恣為貪虐。

translations.literal: Among the affiliated Miao resentment brewed within; the Lu of Wumeng were the most cunning and fierce. Brigadier General Liu Qiyuan was transferred to garrison the area and indulged in greed and oppression.
translations.idiomatic: Resentment festered among the affiliated Miao; the Lu people of Wumeng were especially cunning and fierce. When Brigadier General Liu Qiyuan was transferred to garrison the region, he engaged in unrestrained corruption and cruelty.

sentences.zh: 六月，祿鼎坤及其族人鼎新、萬福遂糾眾攻城，劫殺起元及游擊江仁、知縣賽枝大等，盡戕其孥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Lu Dingkun and his kinsmen Dingxin and Wanfu gathered a mob to storm the city, captured and killed Liu Qiyuan, as well as regimental commander Jiang Ren, magistrate Sai Zhida, and others, and slaughtered all their wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Lu Dingkun and his kinsmen Dingxin and Wanfu raised a force, stormed the city, killed Liu Qiyuan along with regimental commander Jiang Ren and magistrate Sai Zhida, and massacred their families.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰疏聞，請罷斥，上慰諭之。

translations.literal: Oertai reported by memorial and requested to be dismissed; the emperor consoled and reassured him.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai reported the disaster and asked to be removed from office; the emperor comforted him and urged him to continue.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙既陷，江外涼山、下方、阿驢，江內巧家營、者家海諸寨及東川祿氏諸土目皆起而應之，又令則補、以址諸寨要截江路，以則、以擢諸寨窺伺城邑，東川境內挖泥、矣氏、歹補、阿汪諸寨，東川境外急羅箐、施魯、古牛、畢古諸寨，及武定、尋甸、威寧、鎮雄所屬諸夷，遠近響應，殺塘兵，劫糧運，堵要隘，毀橋樑，所在屯聚為亂。

translations.literal: Once Wumeng had fallen, Liangshan, Xiafang, and Alu beyond the river, the stockades of Qiaojia Camp, Zhejiahai, and others within the river, and the Lu native headmen of Dongchuan all rose in response. They also ordered the stockades of Zebu and Yizhi to block the river route, while those of Yize and Yizhuo watched the towns. Within Dongchuan the stockades of Wani, Yishi, Daibu, and Awang, and beyond Dongchuan Jiluoqing, Shilu, Guniu, Bigu, and others, together with the various tribes under Wuding, Xundian, Weining, and Zhenxiong, answered from near and far. They killed garrison soldiers, plundered grain convoys, blocked strategic passes, destroyed bridges, and gathered everywhere in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: After Wumeng fell, Liangshan, Xiafang, and Alu on the far side of the river, stockades such as Qiaojia Camp and Zhejiahai on the near side, and the Lu native headmen of Dongchuan all rose in revolt. Stockades at Zebu and Yizhi were ordered to cut the river route, while those at Yize and Yizhuo lay in wait against the towns. From Wani, Yishi, Daibu, and Awang within Dongchuan to Jiluoqing, Shilu, Guniu, and Bigu beyond its borders, and from the tribes under Wuding, Xundian, Weining, and Zhenxiong, rebels answered from every direction—killing garrison troops, raiding grain transports, holding the passes, tearing down bridges, and massing in rebellion wherever they could.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰集官兵萬數千人，土兵半之，分三路進攻：令總兵魏翥國攻東川；

translations.literal: Oertai assembled more than ten thousand regular troops, with native soldiers equal to half that number, and divided them into three columns to advance: he ordered brigadier general Wei Zhuguo to attack Dongchuan;
translations.idiomatic: Oertai gathered more than ten thousand regular troops, with native auxiliaries numbering half as many again, and launched a three-pronged offensive: brigadier general Wei Zhuguo was to strike Dongchuan;

sentences.zh: 哈元生攻威寧，副將徐成貞副之；

translations.literal: Ha Yuansheng to attack Weining, with vice commander Xu Chengzhen as his deputy;
translations.idiomatic: Ha Yuansheng to attack Weining, assisted by vice commander Xu Chengzhen;

sentences.zh: 參將韓勳攻鎮雄。

translations.literal: regimental commander Han Xun to attack Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: and regimental commander Han Xun to attack Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 翥國師行，土目祿鼎明遣行刺，被創，以總兵官祿代將。

translations.literal: As Zhuguo's army marched, the native headman Lu Dingming sent assassins; Zhuguo was wounded, and brigadier general Guan Lu took command in his place.
translations.idiomatic: As Wei Zhuguo's column advanced, native headman Lu Dingming sent assassins and wounded him; brigadier general Guan Lu replaced him in command.

sentences.zh: 師進，焚苗寨十三。

translations.literal: The army advanced and burned thirteen Miao stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The troops pushed forward and burned thirteen Miao stockades.

sentences.zh: 遣游擊何元攻急羅箐，殺三百餘，降一百三十餘。

translations.literal: He dispatched regimental commander He Yuan to attack Jiluoqing, killing more than three hundred and accepting the surrender of more than one hundred thirty.
translations.idiomatic: He sent regimental commander He Yuan against Jiluoqing, where more than three hundred were killed and more than one hundred thirty surrendered.

sentences.zh: 游擊紀龍攻者家海，破寨，盡殲其眾。

translations.literal: Regimental commander Ji Long attacked Zhejiahai, broke the stockade, and annihilated its entire force.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental commander Ji Long assaulted Zhejiahai, stormed the stockade, and wiped out its defenders to the last man.

sentences.zh: 勳與苗兵遇於莫都，戰一晝夜，破寨四，殺數百人。

translations.literal: Han Xun encountered Miao forces at Modu and fought for a day and a night, breaking four stockades and killing several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xun met Miao fighters at Modu and battled through a day and a night, destroying four stockades and killing several hundred.

sentences.zh: 進攻奎鄉，戰三日，殺二千餘。

translations.literal: He pressed the attack on Kuixiang; after three days of fighting more than two thousand were killed.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed the attack on Kuixiang; after three days of fighting more than two thousand rebels were slain.

sentences.zh: 元生、成貞自威寧攻烏蒙，射殺其渠黑寡、暮末，連破寨八十餘，擊敗其眾數万，遂克烏蒙。

translations.literal: Ha Yuansheng and Xu Chengzhen advanced from Weining against Wumeng, shot dead the chieftains Heiguo and Mumu, broke more than eighty stockades in succession, defeated a force of tens of thousands, and finally captured Wumeng.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Yuansheng and Xu Chengzhen marched from Weining against Wumeng, killed the rebel leaders Heiguo and Mumu by bowshot, overran more than eighty stockades in succession, routed a force numbering in the tens of thousands, and at last recaptured Wumeng.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰檄提督張耀祖督諸軍分道窮搜屠殺，刳腸截脰，分懸崖樹間，群苗讋栗。

translations.literal: Oertai ordered regional commander Zhang Yaozu to lead the armies in separate searches to the end, slaughtering, disemboweling, severing heads, and hanging the parts from cliffs and trees; the Miao masses trembled in fear.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai ordered regional commander Zhang Yaozu to lead the armies in a thorough pursuit, slaughtering rebels, disemboweling corpses, severing heads, and displaying the remains from cliffs and trees until the Miao were struck with terror.

sentences.zh: 上獎鄂爾泰及諸將，以元生、成貞、勳為功首，發帑犒師。

translations.literal: The emperor rewarded Oertai and the generals, naming Ha Yuansheng, Xu Chengzhen, and Han Xun as chief contributors to the victory, and disbursed treasury funds to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended Oertai and his generals, singled out Ha Yuansheng, Xu Chengzhen, and Han Xun as the leading contributors, and issued treasury funds to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 隴慶侯庶母二祿氏、四川沙馬土婦沙氏以不從亂，給誥命，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: The two Lu clanswomen, secondary wives of the Marquis of Longqing, and Lady Sha, native chieftainess of Shama in Sichuan, for refusing to join the rebellion were granted patent letters of appointment and bestowed silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: The two Lu clanswomen, secondary wives of the Marquis of Longqing, and Lady Sha, the native chieftainess of Shama in Sichuan, were granted patent letters of appointment and rewarded with silver and silks for refusing to join the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 於是苗疆复定。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Miao frontier was pacified once again.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao frontier was pacified once again.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰令於雲、貴界上築橋，命曰庚戌橋，以年紀其績也。

translations.literal: Oertai ordered a bridge built on the Yunnan-Guizhou border and named it the Gengxu Bridge, to commemorate the year of his achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai had a bridge built on the Yunnan-Guizhou border and named it the Gengxu Bridge, marking the year of his victory.

sentences.zh: 是歲，永昌邊外孟連土司請歲納廠課六百，鶴慶邊外皦子請歲貢土物，鄂爾泰疏聞。

translations.literal: That year the Menglian native chief beyond Yongchang's border requested to pay six hundred taels annually in mining dues, and the Jiaozi beyond Heqing's border requested to present local products as tribute each year; Oertai reported by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Menglian native chief beyond Yongchang offered to pay six hundred taels in annual mining dues, and the Jiaozi beyond Heqing asked to present local products as tribute; Oertai reported both petitions to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上以邊外野夷向化，命減孟連廠課之半。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering that the wild tribes beyond the border had turned toward civilization, ordered Menglian's mining dues reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that the wild tribes beyond the border had submitted to civilization, the emperor ordered Menglian's mining dues cut in half.

sentences.zh: 皦子入貢，犒以鹽三百斤。

translations.literal: The Jiaozi came to pay tribute and were rewarded with three hundred jin of salt.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiaozi came to pay tribute, they were rewarded with three hundred jin of salt.

sentences.zh: 九年，疏請重定烏蒙、鎮遠、東川、威寧營汛。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he memorialized requesting a reorganization of the garrisons at Wumeng, Zhenyuan, Dongchuan, and Weining.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he memorialized asking that the garrisons at Wumeng, Zhenyuan, Dongchuan, and Weining be reorganized.

sentences.zh: 別疏請興雲南水利，濬嵩明州楊林海，開墾周圍草塘，疏宜良、尋甸諸水，耕東川城北漫海，築浪穹羽河諸堤，修臨安諸處工，暨通粵河道，皆下部議行。

translations.literal: In a separate memorial he requested development of Yunnan's waterworks: dredging Yanglin Lake in Songming Prefecture, opening and reclaiming the surrounding marshlands, channeling the waters of Yiliang, Xundian, and other places, farming the Manhai floodplain north of Dongchuan city, building dikes on the Yu River at Langqiong, repairing works at Lin'an and elsewhere, and opening the river route to Guangdong—all were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: In a separate memorial he proposed a broad program of Yunnan waterworks: dredging Yanglin Lake in Songming, reclaiming surrounding marshlands, channeling rivers at Yiliang and Xundian, farming the Manhai floodplain north of Dongchuan, building dikes on the Yu River at Langqiong, repairing projects at Lin'an and elsewhere, and opening the river route to Guangdong. All were referred to the ministries for approval and implementation.

sentences.zh: 十年，召拜保和殿大學士，兼兵部尚書，辦理軍機事務。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was summoned and appointed Grand Secretary of the Baohe Hall, concurrently Minister of War, to manage Grand Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was summoned to the capital as Grand Secretary of the Baohe Hall, concurrently Minister of War, with charge of Grand Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 敘定苗疆功，部議進世職一等精奇尼哈番，上特命授一等伯爵，世襲。

translations.literal: In recording merit for pacifying the Miao frontier, the ministry recommended advancement to hereditary first-rank jingqi niha fan; the emperor specially ordered conferral of a first-rank earldom, inheritable in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: When honors were recorded for pacifying the Miao frontier, the ministry recommended a hereditary first-rank jingqi niha fan; the emperor instead specially granted a first-rank earldom to be inherited in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 師討準噶爾，六月，命鄂爾泰督巡陝、甘，經略軍務。

translations.literal: As the army campaigned against the Dzungars, in the sixth month Oertai was ordered to inspect Shaanxi and Gansu and take charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: While the army campaigned against the Dzungars, in the sixth month Oertai was ordered to inspect Shaanxi and Gansu and direct military operations.

sentences.zh: 九月，師破敵額爾德尼昭，鄂爾泰檄大將軍張廣泗遣兵截袞塔馬哈戈壁，斷敵北遁道。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the army defeated the enemy at Erdeni-yin Juu; Oertai ordered field marshal Zhang Guangsi to dispatch troops to block the Guntama Gobi and cut off the enemy's northern escape route.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the army defeated the enemy at Erdeni-yin Juu; Oertai ordered field marshal Zhang Guangsi to send troops to block the Guntama Gobi and cut off the enemy's escape to the north.

sentences.zh: 尋疏請屯田。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he memorialized requesting garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: He soon memorialized proposing garrison colonization.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月，還京師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eleventh year he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eleventh year he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 入對，言準部未可驟滅，用兵久，敝中國，無益，上頗然之。

translations.literal: On entering audience he said the Dzungar region could not be swiftly destroyed, that prolonged warfare would exhaust China without benefit; the emperor largely agreed.
translations.idiomatic: In audience he argued that the Dzungars could not be destroyed quickly and that a long war would exhaust the empire to no good end; the emperor largely agreed.

sentences.zh: 十三年，台拱苗复叛。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Taigong Miao rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the Taigong Miao rose in rebellion once more.

sentences.zh: 上命設辦理苗疆事務處，以果親王、寶親王、和親王、鄂爾泰及大學士張廷玉等董其事。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered establishment of an Office for Managing Miao Frontier Affairs, with Princes Guo, Bao, and He, Oertai, and Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu and others to direct its work.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor established an Office for Managing Miao Frontier Affairs, placing Princes Guo, Bao, and He, Oertai, Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu, and others in charge.

sentences.zh: 苗患日熾，焚掠黃平、施秉諸地。

translations.literal: The Miao threat grew daily fiercer, burning and plundering Huangping, Shibing, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao threat intensified daily, with Huangping, Shibing, and other districts burned and plundered.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰以從前佈置未協，引咎請罷斥，並削去伯爵。

translations.literal: Oertai, holding that his earlier arrangements had been inadequate, took blame and requested dismissal, and also asked that his earldom be stripped away.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai, blaming himself for inadequate earlier arrangements, asked to be dismissed and requested that his earldom be revoked.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「國家錫命之恩，有功則受，無功則辭，古今通義。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The state's grace in bestowing honors—merit received when earned, declined when not—has been the universal principle from antiquity to the present."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "In the state's bestowal of honors, one accepts them when earned and declines them when not—this has been the universal principle from antiquity to the present."

sentences.zh: 允其請，予休沐，仍食俸。

translations.literal: He granted the request, gave him leave for rest, and continued his salary.
translations.idiomatic: He granted the request, gave him leave to rest at home, and continued his salary.

sentences.zh: 尋命留三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered to retain third-rank ashainiha fan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon allowed to retain his third-rank ashainiha fan.

sentences.zh: 八月，世宗疾大漸，鄂爾泰仍以大學士與莊親王允祿，果親王允禮，大學士張廷玉，內大臣豐盛額、訥親、海望同被顧命。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, as the Shizong Emperor's illness grew grave, Oertai as Grand Secretary, together with Prince Zhuang Yunlu, Prince Guo Yunli, Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu, and inner ministers Fengsheng'e, Neqin, and Haiwang, was jointly entrusted with the imperial testament.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, as Emperor Shizong's illness grew grave, Oertai as Grand Secretary was named to the regency council along with Prince Zhuang Yunlu, Prince Guo Yunli, Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu, and inner ministers Fengsheng'e, Neqin, and Haiwang.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰與廷玉捧御筆密詔，命高宗為皇太子。

translations.literal: Oertai and Zhang Tingyu received the emperor's secret edict in his own hand, naming the Gaozong Emperor as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai and Zhang Tingyu received the emperor's secret edict in his own hand naming Prince Gaozong as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 俄，皇太子傳旨命鄂爾泰等輔政。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward the crown prince transmitted an edict ordering Oertai and the others to assist in governing.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the crown prince issued an edict ordering Oertai and the others to assist in government.

sentences.zh: 世宗崩，宣遺詔以鄂爾泰志秉忠貞，才優經濟，命他日配享太廟。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor died, the testamentary edict proclaimed that Oertai's will was steadfastly loyal and his talent excelled in statecraft, and ordered that he be enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple after death.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong died, the testamentary edict praised Oertai's steadfast loyalty and superior talent in statecraft and ordered that he be enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple after death.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，命總理事務，進一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the Gaozong Emperor ascended the throne, he was ordered to oversee general affairs and was advanced to first-rank jingqi niha fan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozong ascended the throne, he was put in charge of general affairs and advanced to first-rank jingqi niha fan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年十一月，辭總理事務，授軍機大臣；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of the Qianlong reign he resigned from overseeing general affairs and was appointed a Grand Council minister;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Qianlong 2 he stepped down from overseeing general affairs and was appointed a Grand Council minister;

sentences.zh: 又辭兼管兵部，上不許，加拜他喇布勒哈番，合為三等伯，賜號襄勤。

translations.literal: he also resigned from concurrent charge of the Ministry of War; the emperor would not permit it, and additionally conferred talabuleha fan, combining the titles into third-rank earl, with the honorific name Xiangqin.
translations.idiomatic: he also tried to resign his concurrent charge of the Ministry of War, but the emperor refused; he was further granted talabuleha fan, raising his combined rank to third-rank earl with the honorific name Xiangqin.

sentences.zh: 迭主會試，充領侍衛內大臣、議政大臣、經筵講官。

translations.literal: He presided over the metropolitan examinations in rotation, and served as chief commandant of the guard, deliberative minister, and lecturer at the imperial lecture hall.
translations.idiomatic: He presided over the metropolitan examinations in turn and served as chief commandant of the guard, deliberative minister, and imperial lecturer.

sentences.zh: 四年，南河河道總督高斌請開新運口，河東河道總督白鍾山請復漳河故道，命鄂爾泰按視。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Grand Canal governor-general Gao Bin requested opening a new transport mouth, and East-of-the-Canal governor-general Bai Zhongshan requested restoring the old course of the Zhang River; Oertai was ordered to inspect on site.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Grand Canal governor-general Gao Bin proposed opening a new transport mouth and East-of-the-Canal governor-general Bai Zhongshan proposed restoring the old Zhang River course; Oertai was ordered to inspect both projects on site.

sentences.zh: 尋加太保。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to Senior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to Senior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 七年，副都御史仲永檀以密奏留中事告鄂爾泰長子鄂容安，命王大臣會鞫，請奪鄂爾泰官逮問，上不許。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhong Yongtan reported to Oertai's eldest son E Rong'an regarding a secret memorial withheld by the throne; princes and grand ministers were ordered to conduct a joint inquiry and recommended stripping Oertai of office and arresting him for questioning; the emperor would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhong Yongtan disclosed to Oertai's eldest son E Rong'an the matter of a secret memorial withheld by the throne; princes and grand ministers were ordered to investigate jointly and recommended stripping Oertai of office and arresting him, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 十年，以疾乞解任。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, citing illness, he requested release from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he asked to be relieved of office on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 上慰留，加太傅。

translations.literal: The emperor consoled him and kept him in office, adding Senior Tutor to his titles.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor comforted him, kept him in office, and promoted him to Senior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 卒，命遵遺詔配享太廟，並祀賢良祠，賜祭葬，諡文端。

translations.literal: He died; he was ordered, in accordance with the testamentary edict, to be enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and also worshipped in the Shrine of Worthies, granted imperial funeral rites, and given the posthumous title Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: He died; in accordance with the testamentary edict he was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and also honored in the Shrine of Worthies, granted imperial funeral rites, and given the posthumous title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 二十年，內閣學士胡中藻以詩辭悖逆獲罪，中藻出鄂爾泰門下，鄂爾泰從子甘肅巡撫鄂昌與唱和，並坐譴。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Academician Hu Zhongzao was convicted for seditious language in his poetry; Hu had been a disciple of Oertai, and Oertai's nephew E Chang, governor of Gansu, had exchanged verses with him; both were punished by association.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Academician Hu Zhongzao was convicted for treasonous language in his poetry; as Hu had studied under Oertai and Oertai's nephew E Chang, governor of Gansu, had exchanged verses with him, both were punished by association.

sentences.zh: 上追咎鄂爾泰植黨，命撤出賢良祠。

translations.literal: The emperor retrospectively blamed Oertai for forming a faction and ordered his tablet removed from the Shrine of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor retrospectively blamed Oertai for faction-building and ordered his tablet removed from the Shrine of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰弟鄂爾奇，康熙五十一年進士，改庶吉士，散館授編修。

translations.literal: Oertai's younger brother E Erqi, a jinshi of the fifty-first year of the Kangxi reign, was transferred to the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor and, upon completion of his term, was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai's younger brother E Erqi, a jinshi of Kangxi 51, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor and, after completing his term, was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 雍正中，四遷至侍郎，歷工、禮二部，署兵部。

translations.literal: Under the Yongzheng reign he was promoted four times to vice minister, serving in the Ministries of Works and Rites and acting as minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng he rose through four promotions to vice minister, serving in the Ministries of Works and Rites and acting as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢戶部尚書，兼步軍統領。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to Minister of Revenue and concurrently appointed commandant of the Metropolitan Banner Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to Minister of Revenue and concurrently made commandant of the Metropolitan Banner Garrison.

sentences.zh: 十一年，直隸總督李衛論劾壞法營私、紊制擾民諸狀，鞫實，當治罪，上推鄂爾泰恩，宥之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Zhili governor-general Li Wei memorialized impeaching him for violating the law for private gain, disrupting regulations, and harassing the people; the charges were verified and he was liable to punishment, but the emperor, out of regard for Oertai's grace, pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Zhili governor-general Li Wei impeached him for breaking the law for private gain, disrupting regulations, and harassing the people; the charges were verified and he was liable to punishment, but the emperor pardoned him out of regard for Oertai.

sentences.zh: 十三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the thirteenth year.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰子鄂容安，鄂實，鄂弼，鄂寧，鄂圻，鄂謨。

translations.literal: Oertai's sons were E Rong'an, E Shi, E Bi, E Ning, E Qi, and E Mo.
translations.idiomatic: Oertai's sons were E Rong'an, E Shi, E Bi, E Ning, E Qi, and E Mo.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安自有傳。

translations.literal: E Rong'an has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: E Rong'an has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 鄂實與高天喜同傳。

translations.literal: E Shi shares a biography with Gao Tianxi.
translations.idiomatic: E Shi shares a biography with Gao Tianxi.

sentences.zh: 鄂弼初授三等侍衛，遷正紅旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: E Bi was first appointed third-rank guardsman and was transferred to vice commander of the Plain Red Chinese Banner.
translations.idiomatic: E Bi was first appointed a third-rank guardsman and later transferred to vice commander of the Plain Red Chinese Banner.

sentences.zh: 出為山西巡撫，調陝西，署西安將軍。

translations.literal: He went out as governor of Shanxi, was transferred to Shaanxi, and acted as general of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He served as governor of Shanxi, was transferred to Shaanxi, and acted as general of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 擢四川總督，未上官，卒，賜祭葬，諡勤肅。

translations.literal: He was promoted to governor-general of Sichuan but died before assuming office; he was granted imperial funeral rites and given the posthumous title Qinsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor-general of Sichuan but died before taking office; he was granted imperial funeral rites and given the posthumous title Qinsu.

sentences.zh: 鄂寧，舉人，初授戶部筆帖式。

translations.literal: E Ning, a provincial graduate, was first appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: E Ning, a provincial graduate, began as a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 屢以員外郎署副都統，復自郎中擢禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He repeatedly served as vice commander while holding the rank of department director, and was then promoted from department director to vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly acted as vice commander while holding the rank of department director, then rose from department director to vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 出為湖北巡撫，調湖南，再調雲南。

translations.literal: He went out as governor of Hubei, was transferred to Hunan, and then transferred again to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as governor of Hubei, was transferred to Hunan, and then to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 師徵緬甸，雲南總督楊應琚戰失利，鄂寧以實疏聞。

translations.literal: When the army campaigned against Burma, Yunnan governor-general Yang Yingju suffered defeat in battle; E Ning reported the facts by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: During the Burma campaign, when Yunnan governor-general Yang Yingju suffered defeat, E Ning reported the facts truthfully to the throne.

sentences.zh: 明端代應琚，深入戰死。

translations.literal: Mingrui replaced Yang Yingju, advanced deep into enemy territory, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Mingrui replaced Yang Yingju, advanced deep into enemy territory, and was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 鄂寧劾參贊額勒登額、提督譚五格逗遛失機。

translations.literal: E Ning impeached deputy commander Eledeng'e and regional commander Tan Wuge for dallying and missing their opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: E Ning impeached deputy commander Eledeng'e and regional commander Tan Wuge for dallying and letting the opportunity slip.

sentences.zh: 上獎鄂寧，加內大臣銜，即命代明瑞為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: The emperor commended E Ning, added the title of inner minister, and immediately ordered him to replace Mingrui as governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended E Ning, granted him the inner minister title, and immediately appointed him governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou in Mingrui's place.

sentences.zh: 尋以與參贊舒赫德合疏議撫失上指，奪內大臣銜，左授福建巡撫，迭降藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because he and deputy commander Suhede jointly memorialized proposing pacification contrary to the emperor's intent, his inner minister title was stripped, he was demoted and appointed governor of Fujian, and was successively reduced to blue-plume guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because he and deputy commander Suhede jointly proposed pacification contrary to the emperor's intent, he was stripped of his inner minister title, demoted to governor of Fujian, and successively reduced to blue-plume guardsman.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 張廷玉，字衡臣，安徽桐城人，大學士英次子。

translations.literal: Zhang Tingyu, styled Hengchen, was a native of Tongcheng in Anhui, the second son of Grand Secretary Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyu, styled Hengchen, was a native of Tongcheng, Anhui, and the second son of Grand Secretary Ying.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十九年進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the thirty-ninth year of the Kangxi reign, he was transferred to the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of Kangxi 39, he entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor.

sentences.zh: 散館授檢討，直南書房，以憂歸。

translations.literal: Upon completion of his Hanlin term he was appointed reviser, served in the Southern Study, and returned home on mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: After completing his Hanlin term he was appointed a reviser, served in the Southern Study, and returned home to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 服除，遷洗馬，歷庶子、侍講學士、內閣學士。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was transferred to palace secretary, and successively served as junior tutor, reader-in-waiting, and academician of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was promoted to palace secretary and successively served as junior tutor, reader-in-waiting, and Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he was appointed vice minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he was appointed vice minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 山東鹽販王美公等糾眾倡邪教，巡撫李樹德令捕治，得百五十餘人。

translations.literal: The Shandong salt peddlers Wang Meigong and others gathered a crowd to promote a heterodox sect; Governor Li Shude ordered their arrest, and more than one hundred fifty were seized.
translations.idiomatic: In Shandong the salt peddlers Wang Meigong and others gathered followers to promote a heterodox sect; Governor Li Shude ordered arrests and more than one hundred fifty were seized.

sentences.zh: 上命廷玉與都統託賴、學士登德會勘，戮七人、戍三十五人而讞定。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Zhang Tingyu, banner commander Toloi, and Academician Dengde to conduct a joint investigation; seven were executed, thirty-five banished, and the case was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Zhang Tingyu, banner commander Toloi, and Academician Dengde to investigate jointly; seven were executed, thirty-five banished, and the case was closed.

sentences.zh: 旋調吏部。

translations.literal: He was soon transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，命與翰林院學士阿克敦、勵廷儀應奉几筵祭告文字，賜廕生視一品，擢禮部尚書。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor ascended the throne, he was ordered together with Hanlin Academician Akedun and Li Tingyi to draft the memorial texts for the mourning altar, was granted the privilege of a first-rank yin privilege for a son, and was promoted to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong ascended the throne, he was ordered with Hanlin Academician Akedun and Li Tingyi to draft the mourning-altar memorial texts, granted a first-rank yin privilege for a son, and promoted to Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，復命直南書房。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Yongzheng reign he was again ordered to serve in the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he was again assigned to the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 偕左都御史硃軾充順天鄉試考官，上嘉其公慎，加太子太保。

translations.literal: Together with Censor-in-Chief Zhu Shi he served as examiner for the Shuntian provincial examination; the emperor praised his fairness and prudence and added Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent to his titles.
translations.idiomatic: Serving with Censor-in-Chief Zhu Shi as examiner for the Shuntian provincial examination, he was praised by the emperor for fairness and prudence and promoted to Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋兼翰林院掌院學士，調戶部。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was additionally appointed chancellor of the Hanlin Academy and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became chancellor of the Hanlin Academy in addition to his other duties and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「浙江衢州，江西廣信、贛州，毗連閩、粵，無藉之徒流徙失業，入山種麻，結棚以居，號曰'棚民'。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In Quzhou of Zhejiang and Guangxin and Ganzhou of Jiangxi, adjoining Fujian and Guangdong, rootless persons drifting without employment enter the mountains to plant hemp, build sheds to dwell in, and are called 'shed people.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "In Quzhou, Zhejiang, and Guangxin and Ganzhou, Jiangxi—regions bordering Fujian and Guangdong—rootless drifters without employment enter the mountains to plant hemp, build sheds to live in, and are known as 'shed people.

sentences.zh: 歲月既久，生息日繁。

translations.literal: As years pass their numbers daily increase.
translations.idiomatic: As years pass their numbers grow daily.

sentences.zh: 其強悍者，輒出剽掠。

translations.literal: The fierce among them frequently go out to plunder.
translations.idiomatic: The more violent among them frequently raid and plunder.

sentences.zh: 請敕督撫慎選廉能州縣，嚴加約束。

translations.literal: He requested an edict ordering governors and governors-general carefully to select honest and capable prefects and magistrates to impose strict restraint.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that governors and governors-general be ordered to select honest, capable local officials and impose strict control.

sentences.zh: 其有讀書向學，膂力技勇，察明考驗錄用，庶生聚教訓，初無歧視。」

translations.literal: Those who study and pursue learning, or possess physical strength and martial skill, should upon investigation and examination be enrolled for service, so that in gathering and teaching the people there would from the outset be no discrimination."
translations.idiomatic: Those who study diligently or show physical strength and martial skill should, after investigation and examination, be enrolled for service, so that in settling and educating these people they would not be treated as outcasts from the start."

sentences.zh: 下督撫議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was referred to governors and governors-general for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the governors and governors-general for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 命署大學士事。

translations.literal: He was ordered to act as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to serve as acting Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 四年，授文淵閣大學士，仍兼戶部尚書、翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, while still concurrently serving as Minister of Revenue and chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, retaining his concurrent posts as Minister of Revenue and chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 五年，進文華殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 六年，進保和殿大學士，兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Baohe Hall and concurrently served as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he rose to Grand Secretary of the Baohe Hall and also held the post of Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 七年，加少保。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was granted the title Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 八年，上以西北用兵，命設軍機房隆宗門內，以怡親王允祥、廷玉及大學士蔣廷錫領其事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because the empire was waging war in the Northwest, the emperor ordered that a military affairs office be established inside the Longzong Gate, and the Prince of Yi Yunxiang, Tingyu, and Grand Secretary Jiang Tingsi were charged with directing its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, with campaigns underway in the Northwest, the emperor ordered a military affairs office set up inside the Longzong Gate and put Prince Yi Yunxiang, Zhang Tingyu, and Grand Secretary Jiang Tingsi in charge.

sentences.zh: 嗣改稱辦理軍機處。

translations.literal: It was later renamed the Grand Council for Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: It was later renamed the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 廷玉定規制：諸臣陳奏，常事用疏，自通政司上，下內閣擬旨；

translations.literal: Tingyu established regulations: when officials presented memorials, routine matters used formal memorials submitted through the Office of Transmission, sent down to the Grand Secretariat to draft rescripts;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyu established the regulations: for routine matters officials used formal memorials routed through the Office of Transmission to the Grand Secretariat for rescript drafting;

sentences.zh: 要事用摺，自奏事處上，下軍機處擬旨，親禦硃筆批發。

translations.literal: important matters used palace memorials submitted through the memorial-reading office, sent down to the Grand Council to draft rescripts, which the emperor personally annotated in vermilion and issued.
translations.idiomatic: important matters used folded palace memorials submitted through the memorial office to the Grand Council for drafting, then personally annotated in vermilion by the emperor and issued.

sentences.zh: 自是內閣權移於軍機處，大學士必充軍機大臣，始得預政事，日必召入對，承旨，平章政事，參與機密。

translations.literal: From this time the authority of the Grand Secretariat shifted to the Grand Council; Grand Secretaries had to serve as Grand Councilors before they could participate in state affairs—they were summoned daily for audience, received instructions, deliberated on government, and took part in confidential matters.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Grand Secretariat power shifted to the Grand Council; a Grand Secretary had to serve on the Grand Council to take part in government—summoned daily for audience, receiving instructions, deliberating policy, and sharing in state secrets.

sentences.zh: 廷玉周敏勤慎，尤為上所倚。

translations.literal: Tingyu was thorough, quick-witted, diligent, and cautious, and was especially relied upon by the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyu was thorough, quick, diligent, and cautious, and the emperor relied on him above all others.

sentences.zh: 上偶有疾，獎廷玉等翊贊功，各予一等阿達哈哈番，世襲。

translations.literal: When the emperor was occasionally ill, he commended Tingyu and others for their supporting service and granted each a first-class adaha guardsman title, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor fell briefly ill, he commended Zhang Tingyu and the others for their loyal support and granted each a hereditary first-class adaha guardsman title.

sentences.zh: 廷玉請以子編修若靄承襲。

translations.literal: Tingyu requested that his son, reviser Ruowei, inherit the title.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyu asked that his son Ruowei, a reviser, inherit the title.

sentences.zh: 十一年，疏言：「諸行省例，凡罪人重者收禁，輕者取保。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he memorialized: "By the precedent of the provinces, for all criminals—serious offenders are held in custody, minor ones released on bail.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he submitted a memorial: "Under provincial practice, serious offenders are detained and minor ones released on bail.

sentences.zh: 獨刑部不論事大小、人首從，皆收禁，累無辜。

translations.literal: Only the Ministry of Justice, regardless of the gravity of the case or whether the person was principal or accessory, detains all, harming the innocent.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Justice alone detains everyone regardless of the gravity of the offense or whether the person was principal or accessory, ensnaring the innocent.

sentences.zh: 請如諸行省例，得分別取保。

translations.literal: He requested that, following provincial precedent, release on bail be granted according to distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that bail be granted by category, as in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 刑部引律例，往往刪截，但用數語，即承以所斷罪；

translations.literal: When the Ministry of Justice cited statutes and precedents, it often cut them down, using only a few phrases before proceeding directly to the sentence pronounced;
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Justice often cited statutes in truncated form—a few phrases, then straight to the sentence—

sentences.zh: 甚有求其仿彿，比照定議者：高下其手，率由此起。

translations.literal: and some even sought approximate analogies and decided by comparison: manipulation high and low usually arose from this.
translations.idiomatic: or even hunted for rough analogies and decided by comparison—this is where arbitrary judgments usually begin.

sentences.zh: 請敕都察院、大理寺駁正；

translations.literal: He requested an edict ordering the Censorate and Court of Judicial Review to rebut and correct;
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the Censorate and Court of Judicial Review be ordered to review and overturn faulty rulings;

sentences.zh: 扶同草率，並予處分。」

translations.literal: those who colluded in perfunctory handling were also to be punished."
translations.idiomatic: and that officials who colluded in slipshod work face punishment as well."

sentences.zh: 命九卿議行。
